subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should OpenClaw keep this as one canonical memory/context umbrella, or split it into narrower design tracks for metrics, search scope, session handoff, and restart preload?
rationale: The remaining work changes memory visibility, session-state behavior, API exposure, config defaults, and startup lifecycle behavior, so code inspection cannot decide the correct product/security boundary.

options.title: Keep umbrella, split designs
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical umbrella and create or promote narrower maintainer-sponsored tracks for each API/lifecycle decision before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to sessionMemory
options.body: Close or supersede this umbrella into the existing sessionMemory graduation track and file separate metrics/preload issues only if maintainers want those surfaces soon.

options.title: Plugin-first memory direction
options.body: Route AI-native cross-session memory to plugins such as Honcho or ClawHub packages while keeping only missing core API seams in this repo.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella, split designs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical umbrella and create or promote narrower maintainer-sponsored tracks for each API/lifecycle decision before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He already carried the prior maintainer-facing review for this umbrella and is the clearest routing candidate from the available discussion/history.
